en.headline: MTR receives four bids for Tuen Mun Area 16 Phase 2
en.dek: Tendering closed on Wednesday for the large railway-topside scheme beside the future Tuen Mun South Extension station, with results to be announced later.
body: MTR Corporation said it received four tender submissions on Wednesday for the Tuen Mun Area 16 Station Package Two property development on Tuen Mun Town Lot No. 576, after bids closed at 2pm. The corporation said it would consider the submissions in detail and announce the result later.

The scheme sits beside Tuen Mun River Channel and the Area 16 station now being built on the Tuen Mun South Extension, which is due to extend the Tuen Ma Line from Tuen Mun station towards Tuen Mun South, with completion targeted for 2030. MTR earlier invitation materials said the package would connect to the station and include shopping, community facilities and a public transport interchange, with a maximum residential gross floor area of 249,979 square metres and a maximum commercial gross floor area of 31,100 square metres. Local reports put the residential yield at about 5,510 flats.

Property director David Tang Chi-fai told reporters after the close that the corporation was confident about the response, citing housing demand, Tuen Mun established community and the future rail link. He said MTR planned, subject to market conditions, to tender two smaller projects over the next three to four quarters providing more than 2,000 flats in total. Market reports named Sun Hung Kai Properties, which won Phase 1 last November, CK Asset and Henderson Land as solo bidders, with a consortium of Sino Land, Kerry Properties, China Overseas and Great Eagle also submitting.

Twenty-eight expressions of interest were received in July. Surveyors quoted in local media have put a wide range on the land value. MTR is responsible for the land premium under the tender terms described in those reports. The winning bidder has not been named.

zh.headline: 港鐵屯門第16區站第二期收四份標書
zh.dek: 毗鄰興建中屯門南延絲第16區站的大型上蓋項目周三截標，港鐵稱稍後公布結果，市場估計項目可提供約5,510伙。
body: 港鐵公司表示，屯門市地段第576號用地的屯門第16區站第二期物業發展項目於周三下午2時截標，共收到四份標書。港鐵稱會詳細考慮有關標書，稍後公布招標結果。
項目毗鄰屯門河道及興建中的屯門南延絲第16區站。屯門南延絲將把屯馬絲由屯門站經第16區站延伸至屯門南，目標於2030年竣工。港鐵較早前公布，第二期會無縫連接車站，並設商場、社區設施及公共運輸交匯處，住宅總樓面面積上限為249,979平方米，商業總樓面面積上限為31,100平方米。本地報道指項目料提供約5,510個單位。
港鐵常務總監（物業及國際業務）鄧智輝截標後對記者表示，對反應有信心，指本港對房屋有需求，屯門屬成熟社區，項目亦連接未來鐵路站。他說港鐵未來三至四季會視乎市況，準備再推兩個規模較小的項目招標，合共提供逾2,000個單位。市場消息指新鴻基地產、長江實業及恒基兆業以獨資入標，新地去年11月已投得第一期；信和置業則聯同嘉里建設、中國海外及鷹君組財團入標。
項目7月共收到28份發展意向書。測量師在本地傳媒引述的估值差距較大。報道指招標條款下補地價由港鐵負責。中標發展商尚未公布。
